deg_to_rad.label: Degrees to radians
deg_to_rad.description:
Converts an angle input from degrees to radians, which is the most commonly used in Substance.
For GUI only needs, it is recommended to use the Angle Editor along with a Float1 value type.
Use this function in another when you need to convert angle value types.

asin.label: asin
asin.description: Returns the arc sine of entry value: asin(x).

acos.label: acos
acos.description: Returns the arc cosine of entry value: acos(x).

EvenCount.label: Even count
EvenCount.description: Returns the count of even numbers contained in the input.

OddCount.label: Odd count
OddCount.description: Returns the count of odd numbers contained in the input.

ParityTest.label: Parity test
ParityTest.description: Returns true if the input is a even number.

Ln.label: Ln
Ln.description: The Ln function returns the Natural logarithm value of entry.

Pow.label: Pow (Deprecated)
Pow.description:
Returns x^n.

This function is now deprecated as the engine v9 provides an atomic Pow function.

distance_vec3.label: Distance Float3
distance_vec3.description: Returns the Euclidean distance between two points.

distance_vec2.label: Distance Float2
distance_vec2.description: Returns the Euclidean distance between two points (in 2D).

length_vec2.label: Length Float2
length_vec2.description: Returns scalar Euclidean length of a vector float2.

length_vec3.label: Length Float3
length_vec3.description: Returns scalar Euclidean length of a vector float3.

sign.label: Sign
sign.description: Returns the sign of a scalar. If X == 0, returns 1.

reflect.label: Reflect
reflect.description: Returns the reflectiton vector given an incidence vector and a normal vector.

fmod.label: Fmod
fmod.description: Returns the remainder of a/b with the same sign as a.

frac.label: Frac
frac.description: Returns the fractional portion of a scalar.

cross_product.label: Cross product
cross_product.description: Returns the cross product of two three-component vectors

cross_product_vec2.label: Cross product Vec2
cross_product_vec2.description: Returns the cross product of two two-component vectors

step.label: Step
step.description: Returns one if x is greater than or equal to a, and zero otherwise.

divide_float4.label: Scalar division Float4
divide_float4.description: Divide a float 4 by a given scalar.

divide_float3.label: Scalar division Float3
divide_float3.description: Divide a float 3 by a given scalar.

divide_float2.label: Scalar division Float2
divide_float2.description: Divide a float 2 by a given scalar.

clamp.label: Clamp
clamp.description: Returns Min or Max if the input is outside of the Min/Max range.

smoothstep.label: Smoothstep
smoothstep.description: Smooth interpolation between A and B in function of X.

saturate_float2.label: Saturate Float2
saturate_float2.description:
For each vector component:
- Returns 0 if input is lower than 0.
- Returns 1 if input is greater than 1.

average_float1.label: Average Float1
average_float1.description: Returns the average value of A and B.

average_float2.label: Average Float2
average_float2.description: Returns the average value of A and B.

average_float3.label: Average Float3
average_float3.description: Returns the average value of A and B.

average_float4.label: Average Float4
average_float4.description: Returns the average value of A and B.

orthogonal_vec2.label: Orthogonal Vec2
orthogonal_vec2.description: Returns an orthognal vector of the input vec2.

saturate.label: Saturate
saturate.description:
- Returns 0 if input is lower than 0.
- Returns 1 if input is greater than 1.

truncate_float1_decimals.label: Truncate Float1
truncate_float1_decimals.description: Truncates a Float1's to a specific amount of decimals.

round_float1.label: Round Float1
round_float1.description: Rounds a Float 1. Rounds up when decimal is greater or equal than 0.5

Uniform_[A,B[.label: Random uniform [a, b[
Uniform_[A,B[.description: This function returns a floating random value between value A and value B.

Uniform_[-1,1[.label: Random uniform [-1, 1[
Uniform_[-1,1[.description: This function returns a floating random value between -1 and 1.

Degrees_to_Turn.label: Degrees to turns
Degrees_to_Turn.description: This function converts a degree floating value (0 to 360] to turns (0 to 1).

GlobalRandom.label: Global random
GlobalRandom.description: This Pseudo-Random function generates a floating  random value between 0 and the entry value. The seed value is local to the function (same inputs will always give the same results).

normal_distribution.label: Normal distribution
normal_distribution.description:
Converts a Vec2 Uniform Random value into a Normal Distribution.
Resulting range is [-radius, radius].

Directional_Offset.label: Directional offset
Directional_Offset.description:
This function returns a float2 ranging from (-1.0, -1.0) to (1.0, 1.0), based on its Direction and Distance inputs.
The Direction is calibrated to the left, same as every filters in Substance.

MatrixMultiply.label: Matrix multiply
MatrixMultiply.description:
This function returns a Float4 Transform Matrix that is the Matrix product of its two Matrix intputs.
It is useful for combining a Rotation Matrix and a Scale Matrix.

RotationMatrix.label: Rotation matrix
RotationMatrix.description:
This function returns a Float4 Transform Matrix that spins as its RotationW changes.
The RotationW is expected in #Turns.

ScaleMatrix.label: Scale matrix
ScaleMatrix.description: This function returns a Float4 Transform Matrix that scales as its ScaleUV changes.

TileMatrix.label: Tile matrix
TileMatrix.description: This function returns a Float4 Transform Matrix that tiles in function of the X/Y input.

rotate_vec2.label: Rotate Vec2
rotate_vec2.description: Rotates a Vec2 around a Pivot.

rotate_vec2_rad.label: Rotate Vec2 (Radian)
rotate_vec2_rad.description: Rotates a Vec2 given an angle value [0, 2Pi].

Wave.label: Wave
Wave.description:
This function returns a Float1 value that oscillates over $time.
It has Amplitude and Frequency inputs.

Height_Balance_Fn.label: Height balance
Height_Balance_Fn.description:
This function returns a float4 in which :
X is minimum of the Higher
Y is maximum of the Higher
Z is minimum of the Lower
W is maximum of the Lower
The input goes from -1.0 to 1.0.
A 0 value input returns a balanced output of 0.0 ; 0.5 ; 0.5 ; 1.0.

[0,1]_to_[0,1,0].label: [0,1] to [0,1,0]
[0,1]_to_[0,1,0].description: Moves centre of gradient to middle 0.5, expands range. Good for bi-directional gradient.

[a,b]_to_[0,1].label: [a,b] to [0,1]
[a,b]_to_[0,1].description: Returns position of input X, between min a, max b as a float between 0 and 1.Works as a reverse linear interpolation.

triangle_wave.label: Triangle wave
triangle_wave.description: repeats gradient range from 0 to 1 back to 0, giving a mirrored effect, like a sawtooth function, at every whole number.

sawtooth_wave.label: Sawtooth wave
sawtooth_wave.description: Repeats range to  [0,1], like texture coordinate tiling. Modulo adjusted to peak at 1, instead of back to 0.

booleanToFloat1.label: Boolean to Float1
booleanToFloat1.description:
This function converts a boolean type value to a float1 value.
If True returns 1.0, else 0.0

directionToNormal.label: Direction to normal
directionToNormal.description: This function returns a Normal Map color that matches the directions provided.

temperature_to_rgb.label: Temperature to RGB
temperature_to_rgb.description: Converts a temperature in Kelvin to RGB values.

hsl_offset.label: HSL offset
hsl_offset.description: Offsets and RGBA value by adding hue, saturation or lightness inputs. Returns the adjusted value as RGBA.

non_square_output_size.label: Non-square output size
non_square_output_size.description:
Mainly used in FX-Map noises:
Computes:
- render_region
- tiling_region
- xy_difference
- xy_ratio

To be used along with an Iterate node to duplicate the noise in function of the Image Ratio.

non_square_output_size_v2.label: Non-square output size
non_square_output_size_v2.description:
Mainly used in FX-Map noises:
Computes:
- render_region (float4)
- tiling_region (float4)
- xy_difference (float)
- xy_ratio (float2)
- total_number (int)

To be used along with an Iterate node to duplicate the noise in function of the Image Ratio.

non_square_expansion_uv_scale.label: Non-square expansion UV scale
non_square_expansion_uv_scale.description: Scale UVs and maintain the [0, 1] square in the center in function of the image size ratio.
